supporting_pages.title: Manage users in the Apigee UI \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Note: Before you can add a new user (and specify environment-specific access for that new user) in the Apigee UI, you must grant that user access to the Google Cloud project, as described in Managing access in Google Cloud .

When you first configure Apigee and create the Google Cloud project to which the Apigee organization is bound, you typically add a few users with different roles like API Admin and Environment Admin .
